formulations.name: Raktapitta Basti 2 (Gambhari-Badari group)

formulations.name: Raktapitta Basti 4 (Manjishtha-Sariva group – internal haemorrhage)

formulations.preparation_method: Decoction with added ingredients administered as enema

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 1 (Musta-Ushira-Bala group – sustaining enema)
formulations.preparation_method: Herbs decocted in 2.56 litres water reduced to one-fourth. Decoction re-boiled with milk 1.28 litres till only milk remains. Added with one-fourth meat juice, equal honey and ghee, paste of specified herbs, and rock salt. Administered warmly.
indications: Stiffness in knee, thigh, shanks and pelvis
Disorders of vata, rakta, pitta and kapha

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 2 (Eranda-Palasha group – sustaining enema for all)
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs boiled in 2.56 litres water mixed with one-fourth milk till reduced to one-fourth. Filtered and added with pastes, honey, ghee, oil and rock salt. Administered tepidly as enema once, twice or thrice.

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 3 (Sahachara-Bala-Darbha-Sariva milk enema)
formulations.preparation_method: Roots prepared in milk and administered as enema

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 4 (Brhati-Kantakari-Shatavari-Guduchi milk enema)
formulations.preparation_method: Milk boiled with herbs, added with paste of madhuka, madanaphala and pippali

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 5 (Bala-Atibala-Vidari group – for cough, fever, gulma etc.)
formulations.preparation_method: Roots boiled in milk, added with paste, honey, ghee and sauvarchala salt

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 6 (Bala-Atibala-Dashamula group – for Vata retention)
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs boiled in 10.24 litres water till reduced to administrable quantity for enema. Strained and added with pastes and liquid ingredients. Administered tepidly.
indications: Retention of semen, urine and faeces caused by Vata
Stiffness in sides, back and waist

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 7 (Hapusa-Barley group – for Vata-Rakta)
formulations.preparation_method: Hapusa and barley boiled in milk mixed with water till only milk remains. Added with honey, ghee, oil and salt. Administered as enema.
indications: Promotes intellect, sharpness of mind, digestive fire and strength

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 8 (Laghu Panchamula-Pippali-Maduka group – for intermittent fever)
formulations.preparation_method: Laghu panchamula decoction prepared in milk mixed with water; added with pippali, madhuka, madana, jaggery, ghee, oil and salt

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 9 (Bala-Atibala-Kapikachhu group – for old and debilitated)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction with added jaggery, ghee, oil and salt administered as enema

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 10 (Bala-Madhuka-Vidari group – for fever)
formulations.preparation_method: Roots boiled with goat's milk till milk remains. Added with paste, honey, ghee and rock salt.

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 11 (Shalaparni-Prishniparni-Gokshuraka group – for weak senses in intermittent fever)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction prepared with 640 ml each of goat's milk and water. Added with paste of pippali, madhuka and utpala, along with ghee and rock salt.

formulations.name: Yapana Basti 12 (Goat milk-Sali-Yava group – aphrodisiac enema)
formulations.preparation_method: Goat's milk boiled with laghu panchamula and grains reduced to one-fourth. Added with juice of hen's egg, honey, ghee, sugar and salts.

formulations.name: Kapha-Basti Shodhana (Dashamula-Triphala-Kutaja group – for Kapha disorders)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction prepared in cow's urine, added with pastes of specified herbs, rock salt, yavakshara, honey and oil
